features_verified: 1. 'Add' button on Raw Materials tab opens dialog with correct new columns: Item Name, Qty, Pack Wt, Unit, Price, Total, $/Unit
2. 'Add Item' button inside dialog creates a new empty editable row with all fields
3. Unit field is a dropdown selector with options: LB, KG, OZ, EA, CS, BX, GAL, L, BAG, PK (and a blank '—' option)
4. Filling in quantity and unit_price auto-calculates total (total = qty * unit_price)
5. Filling in pack_weight recomputes normalized_unit_price (unit_price / pack_weight) and displays as $/Unit
6. $/Unit shows '—' when pack_weight is 0 or empty, and shows a teal-colored dollar amount when computed
7. View detail dialog for an existing purchase shows new columns: Pack Wt, Unit, $/Unit
8. Save a new purchase with pack_weight and unit data, then re-open/view it to verify data persists correctly
9. Edit an existing purchase — pack_weight and unit fields should be populated and editable
10. Delete a line item inside the dialog works correctly
11. Sales page and Other Expenses page are NOT affected — they do NOT have pack_weight/unit changes
12. Backend POST /api/purchases accepts and stores pack_weight and normalized_unit_price in item data
